author: Zintenka
body: If a map were to be made in 1.8 but didnt use 1.8 blocks and the yml was done in 1.8-based stuff would it work for Avicus?
body_tagged: If a map were to be made in 1.8 but didnt use 1.8 blocks and the yml was done in 1.8-based stuff would it work for Avicus?
title: Map question

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: Any chests and signs that you place will mess up when the map is transferred to Avicus (They will be empty/blank). Just use 1.7 to save the all the trouble.
replies.body_tagged: Any chests and signs that you place will mess up when the map is transferred to Avicus (They will be empty/blank). Just use 1.7 to save the all the trouble.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: coords are still the same, but chests and signs are messed up.
replies.body_tagged: coords are still the same, but chests and signs are messed up.
